unit: 时态进阶 · 过去将来时
summary: 站在过去看将来：would / was going to + 动词原形，常用于宾语从句与记叙文，是直接引语变间接引语的必考时态。
signals: the next day / the following week

rules.title: would + 动词原形：宾语从句中的将来
rules.detail: 主句是过去时（said / told / promised / thought...），从句表示「从过去看将要发生」的动作，用 would do。

examples.en: They said they would visit us the following week.
examples.zh: 他们说下一周会来看我们。

examples.en: He promised that he would never make the same mistake again.
examples.zh: 他保证再也不犯同样的错误。

rules.title: was/were going to + 动词原形：过去的打算
rules.detail: 表示过去某时的计划、打算或即将发生的事；也常表示「本来打算（却没做成）」。

examples.en: I didn't know you were going to leave so soon.
examples.zh: 我不知道你这么快就要走。

examples.en: She was going to tell him the truth, but she changed her mind.
examples.zh: 她本打算告诉他真相，但改变了主意。

rules.title: was/were about to do 与 was/were to do
rules.detail: was/were about to do 表示「正要、即将」（常与 when 连用）；was/were to do 表示按过去安排或注定要发生的事。

examples.en: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我们正要离开，电话响了。

examples.en: The meeting was to be held the following week.

pitfalls: 间接引语漏变时态：❌ He said he will come the next day. → ✓ He said he would come the next day.
时间状语忘跟着变：直接引语中的 tomorrow / next week 在间接引语中要变 the next day / the following week
「正要……这时……」用 was about to...when...：when 后的句子用一般过去时（when it began to rain）

rows.l: He says he will come tomorrow.
rows.r: He said he would come the next day.
the next day / the following week

questions.stem: He said he ___ me as soon as he arrived in Beijing.
questions.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句的「将打电话」用过去将来时 would call。

questions.stem: I ___ tell her the news, but she had already known it.
questions.explain: 「本打算告诉她」用 was going to tell，表示过去未实现的打算。

questions.stem: We were about to leave ___ it began to rain.
questions.explain: be about to do...when... 表示「正要……这时……」，when 引出突然发生的事。

questions.stem: She promised that she ___ (send) me an email the next week.
questions.explain: promised 过去时，从句用过去将来时 would send；the next week 也是过去语境的「下周」。

questions.stem: They said there ___ (be) a football match the following day.
questions.explain: 站在 said 之时看「第二天」的将来，用过去将来时 would be。

questions.stem: He told me that he will help me with my English.
questions.explain: 直接引语变间接引语：主句 told 过去时，will 要相应变为 would。

questions.stem: 她说她第二天要动身去巴黎。（翻译整句，leave for）
answer: she said that she would leave for paris the next day.
she said she would leave for paris the next day.
questions.explain: 主句 said 过去时，从句用过去将来时 would leave；the next day 是过去的「第二天」。

questions.stem: 我们不知道他们下一步打算做什么。（翻译整句）
answer: we didn't know what they were going to do next.
we did not know what they were going to do next.
questions.explain: didn't know 过去时，宾语从句中的「打算做」用过去将来时 were going to do。
